title: Counting Pairwise Handshakes
problem: At a gathering of n people, how many handshakes take place if every pair meets once? Justify the count and state clearly whether a person may shake their own hand.

strategies.title: Direct counting
strategies.approach: Derive a general count from the stated setup. Check small group sizes, explain why every handshake is counted exactly once, and identify any assumption that changes the answer.
